# Archived GitHub Workflows

This directory preserves completed one-shot release, milestone, research, diagnostic and historical validation workflows for reproducibility while keeping `.github/workflows/` limited to durable operational automation.

Historical workflow runs remain available in GitHub Actions and Git history. Moving a workflow here does not erase successful or failed evidence.

## Preserved snapshots

- `release-alpha4/` — Alpha.4 release-specific automation.
- `release-alpha5/` — Alpha.5 qualification and release-specific automation.
- `pre-operational-cleanup-2026-10-01/` — exact tree snapshot of the active workflow directory immediately before the professional operational cleanup. It preserves every historical workflow that was removed from the active Actions surface in that cleanup.

The active workflow set is documented in `.github/workflows/README.md`.

Archival is repository hygiene only. It must never be used to reinterpret, hide or delete negative evidence, failed runs or closed-gate history.
